import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f22 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0022.png').convert('RGB'))

# Find lamp base in F22
lamp_base = (f22[350:450, 120:200, 0] > 70) & (f22[350:450, 120:200, 0] < 120) & (f22[350:450, 120:200, 2] > 90)
y, x = np.where(lamp_base)
print('F22 lamp base y_max:', 350 + y.max(), 'x_mean:', 120 + np.mean(x))

f = 256.0
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5
h = 1.55

y_max = 350 + y.max()
x_m = 120 + np.mean(x)
z_cam = f * h / (y_max - cy)
x_cam = (x_m - cx) * z_cam / f
print(f'Camera coords: z={z_cam:.3f}, x={x_cam:.3f}')
# In F22, pose is (1.0, 2.5), heading is 0 deg (+y)
print(f'Lamp world: X={1.0 + x_cam:.3f}, Y={2.5 + z_cam:.3f}')
"
